description.value: Country Grocer Royal Oak is a 29,000-square-foot, family-owned Vancouver Island supermarket anchoring the Royal Oak Shopping Centre just north of Victoria, offering a full-service meat counter, deli, bakery, and floral centre. It is part of an eleven-store Island chain with over four decades of history and a strong commitment to local sourcing from BC farmers and producers. The Royal Oak team actively supports local cycling initiatives, including the Cycle of Life Tour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's location page for Royal Oak confirms the store is operational with address 4420 West Saanich Rd, Victoria, BC V8Z 3E9, phone 250-708-3919, and store manager details matching OSM tags. The site describes a 29,000-square-foot full-service supermarket with deli, bakery, meat counter, and floral centre but makes no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those are left null. Basic groceries is confirmed as true by the store's own description of a comprehensive, full-service grocery operation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible full-service supermarket with confirmed contact details and an operating website. Useful to touring cyclists for resupply.

wow_evidence: eleven-store Island chain with over four decades of history... actively supports local cycling initiatives, including the Cycle of Life Tour
